title: Dxcufgb's Familiar Faces & Places
description: A sidebar tab of everyone the party has met and every place they have been, with a Faces, a Places and a Factions list. The GM adds NPCs and places from the journals (select a name and right-click it, or right-click a journal or page), NPCs from the Actors directory or an NPC's token, places from the Scenes directory, and gives them pictures by right-clicking journal images. Players add the NPCs they meet by right-clicking a token and the places they visit to their own lists, and keep notes about each NPC and place: private, shared with the party, or with chosen players. NPCs and places link to each other: a place shows the people met there, an NPC the places they belong to. Factions (guilds, houses, cults) link to any number of NPCs and places, each with a role, and have notes of their own. Search everything, group NPCs by where they were met and places by region, and use it alongside Dxcufgb's Quest log: new notes link the quests, rewards and party notes they mention.
